sections.section: RULES - Diyat Arsh and Daman Rules 2007
sections.description:
DIYAT, ARSH AND DAMAN RULES, 2007
DIYAT, ARSH AND DAMAN RULES, 2007
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
20th June, 2011]
S.R.O. 632(I)/2011, dated 17-6-2011.---In exercise of the
powers conferred by subsection (2) of section 338G of the Pakistan Penal Code
(Act XLV of 1860) with the approval of administrative committee of the Diyat,
Arsh and Daman Fund 2007 the Federal Government is pleased to direct that, in
the Diyat, Arsh and Daman Rules, 2007, the following amendments shall be made,
namely:--
In the aforesaid rules,--
(I) in rule 3,--
(a) in sub-rule (2), in clause (a), after the
word "annual" the words "and other" shall be inserted; and
(b) in sub-rule (4), for the word
"Administration" the word "Administrative" shall be
substituted;
(II) in rule 4, in sub-rule (4), after the word
"months" the words and comma "and apart from holding meeting at
the Federal Capital, the meetings may be held at each Provincial headquarters
on rotation basis" shall be inserted;
(III) for rule 5 the following shall be substituted,
namely:--
"5. Delegation of powers.---The
Administrative Committee may, subject to such conditions and limitation as it
deems fit, delegate all or any of its powers of Provincial Sub-committees, to
be chaired by home secretaries and having a member of the Federal Government,
for disposal of business under these rules.";
(IV) in rule 6, in sub-rule (2), after the word
"not" the word "be" shall be inserted;
(V) in rule 7,--
(a) in sub-rule (1),--
(i) in clause (b), the word "and"
shall be committed;
(ii) in clause (c), for the full stop a semi-colon
and the word ";and" shall be added, namely:--
(iii) after
clause (c), amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause (d) shall be added, namely:--
"(d) in case diyat exceeds rupees five hundred
thousand the excess amount may be paid through grant."; and
(b) for sub-rule (2) the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"(2) For the purpose of sub-rule (1), the Federal
Government and, if so desired by the Federal Government, the State Bank shall
issue instructions to the scheduled banks to advance soft loans, at a rate of
interest not exceeding one per cent inclusive of all costs, or interest free
loans to convicts for the purposes of these rules. Moreover, the State Bank may
also advise the Islamic Banks to pay, from their charity funds, diyat, daman or
arsh of destitute prisoners,";
(VI) in rule 8, for sub-rule (1) the following shall
be substituted, namely:--
"(1) The grant out of the Fund may be provided to--
(a) a convict who is incapacitated due to
physical or 'mental illness, women with children, orphans, juvenile prisoners
and prisoners who have crossed age of sixty year; and
(b) the women with children, orphans, juvenile
prisoners and prisoners and prisoners
who have crossed age of sixty years and have undergone their major portion of
imprisonment but can not pay the amount of diyat, arsh or daman."; and
(VII) in rule 11 the
words "on parole", wherever occurring, shall be omitted.
